fact: Seven members of the Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel took the legal oath at Nouakchott on 22 February 2024 under article 70 of law 2017-020, before taking up office at the body charged with overseeing all personal-data processing in Mauritania.
title: Des membres de l'Autorité de protection des données personnelles prêtent serment
why_not: Swearing-in of the data-protection authority's members states no mandate over AI; parent's review 2026-10-20.
